title: 👀 Gajjala's Watch — your tickers on 1-, 3- and 5-minute bars from 04:00 ET
full_text: Your watch holds 12 tickers — remove one to add another
empty_text: No tickers yet — add one above.

info.honesty: A 9-over-21 cross is information, not an entry. UNMEASURED: nothing has measured what follows a cross on these frames.
info.push_text: 👀 Gajjala's Watch marks every 9 / 21 EMA cross on your tickers' 1-, 3- and 5-min charts (closed bars); a cross ABOVE on the latest closed 1-min bar rings once per ticker, frame and session (the 🧠 alert kind). UNMEASURED — information, not an entry.
info.uptrend_rule: K5 uptrend: 9 EMA above the 21 EMA and both higher than 3 bars ago
info.auto_text: 🤖 Gajjala's Watch adds, once a minute during the 04:00–20:05 ET pass window, the 🧠 potentials the 🚩 5-min, 🚩 1-min and 🧪 boards serve with today's volume at or over 1,000,000 shares (GG's K11 floor; the scan row, else the pass's own stored number), up to 18 at a time, in the order added; an auto name leaves the watch when every board reads it ↩️ back under or ✖️ stop printed, or when it has been a potential nowhere for 5 minutes; ⏸ waiting above its trigger stays; your own names are never touched; auto names do not ring the 1-min cross (mode off). UNMEASURED.
